title: Identifying Implicit Social Biases in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the racial distribution of the top-100 retrieved facial images from the FairFace dataset by calculating the cosine similarity (C-ASC metric) between text embeddings of stereotype-associated words and image embeddings, and measuring the normalized entropy of the retrieved racial demographic groups.

Evaluating the gender distribution of the top-100 retrieved facial images from the FairFace dataset by calculating the cosine similarity (C-ASC metric) between text embeddings of stereotype-associated words and image embeddings, and measuring the normalized entropy of the retrieved gender demographic groups.
